entries.title: Isaiah 14:1
segments: ¶For Jehovah will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in rest in their own land; and the stranger shall be united to them, and they shall be joined to the house of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:2
segments: And the peoples shall take them and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah for servants and handmaids; and they shall take them captive whose captives they were, and they shall rule over their oppressors.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:3
segments: And it shall come to pass in the day that Jehovah shall give thee rest from thy sorrow and from thy trouble and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

entries.title: Isaiah 14:4
segments: ¶that thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased, --the exactress of gold ceased!

entries.title: Isaiah 14:5
segments: Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:6
segments: He that smote the peoples in wrath with a relentless stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted unsparingly.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:7
segments: The whole earth is at rest, is quiet: they break forth into singing.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:8
segments: Even the cypresses rejoice at thee, the cedars of Lebanon, [saying,] Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:9
segments: Sheol from beneath is moved for thee to meet [thee] at thy coming, stirring up the dead for thee, all the he-goats of the earth; making to rise from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:10
segments: All of them shall answer and say unto thee, Art thou also become powerless as we; art thou become like unto us!

entries.title: Isaiah 14:11
segments: --Thy pomp is brought down to Sheol, the noise of thy lyres: the maggot is spread under thee, and worms cover thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:12
segments: How art thou fallen from heaven, Lucifer, son of the morning! Thou art cut down to the ground, that didst prostrate the nations!

entries.title: Isaiah 14:13
segments: And thou that didst say in thy heart, I will ascend into the heavens, I will exalt my throne above the stars of *God, and I will sit upon the mount of assembly, in the recesses of the north;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:14
segments: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds, I will be like the Most High:

entries.title: Isaiah 14:15
segments: none the less art thou brought down to Sheol, to the recesses of the pit.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:16
segments: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee; they shall consider thee, [saying,] Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that shook kingdoms;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:17
segments: [that] made the world as a wilderness, and overthrew the cities thereof; [that] dismissed not his prisoners homewards?

entries.title: Isaiah 14:18
segments: --All the kings of the nations, all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:19
segments: but thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, covered with the slain--those thrust through with the sword, that go down to the stones of the pit: like a carcase trodden under foot.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:20
segments: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial; for thou hast destroyed thy land, hast slain thy people. Of the seed of evildoers no mention shall be made for ever.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:21
segments: Prepare ye slaughter for his children, because of the iniquity of their fathers; that they may not rise up and possess the earth, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:22
segments: For I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and scion and descendant, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:23
segments: And I will make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water; and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:24
segments: ¶Jehovah of hosts hath sworn saying, Assuredly as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, it shall stand:

entries.title: Isaiah 14:25
segments: to break the Assyrian in my land; and upon my mountains will I tread him under foot; and his yoke shall depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:26
segments: This is the counsel which is purposed concerning the whole earth; and this is the hand which is stretched out upon all the nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:27
segments: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall frustrate [it]? And his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

entries.title: Isaiah 14:28
segments: In the year of the death of king Ahaz was this burden:

entries.title: Isaiah 14:29
segments: Rejoice not thou, Philistia, all of thee, because the rod that smote thee is broken; for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a viper, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:30
segments: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; but I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:31
segments: Howl, O gate! cry, O city! thou, Philistia, art wholly dissolved; for there cometh from the north a smoke, and none remaineth apart in his gatherings [of troops].

entries.title: Isaiah 14:32
segments: And what shall be answered to the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah hath founded Zion, and the afflicted of his people find refuge in it.
